title: Link feature specifications to requirements
goal: Make each active feature traceable to the functional or non-functional requirements it addresses, and have the harness reject missing or invalid references before implementation.
in_scope: Add a requirement_ids array to feature specification JSON files.
Discover stable FR- and NFR-style IDs from Markdown requirement documents under the repository's requirements/ directory.
Update harness validation so planned and in-progress features require at least one requirement ID and every populated reference resolves to an ID in the requirement documents.
Apply the same requirement-reference completeness and existence checks in ready and approve before implementation can begin.
Allow existing completed feature specifications to omit requirement links for backward compatibility; validate any links they do contain.
Update README.md to explain the requirement_ids field, requirement document location and ID format, and validation behavior.
out_of_scope: Automatically inferring which requirements a feature satisfies.
Forcing retroactive requirement links onto completed legacy features.
Changing how requirements interviews are conducted.
acceptance_criteria: Active feature specifications include one or more requirement_ids.
harness.py validate reports missing IDs for active features and unknown IDs in any populated requirement_ids list.
ready and approve reject a planned feature when its requirement_ids are missing or do not resolve.
Requirement IDs are read from Markdown files under requirements/ using stable FR-NNN and NFR-NNN forms.
Completed legacy features without requirement_ids remain valid, preserving the current registry.
README.md documents how to define and link requirement IDs.
